target.title: fix(codex-supervisor): guard loadCodexSupervisorEndpoints JSON.parse against malformed env input
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators using `OPENCLAW_CODEX_SUPERVISOR_ENDPOINTS` would receive a raw
`SyntaxError` during startup when the value began with `[` but contained malformed JSON.

## Why This Change Was Made

The endpoint parser now catches JSON decoding failures at its configuration boundary and reports
`OPENCLAW_CODEX_SUPERVISOR_ENDPOINTS must be a valid JSON array.` Existing parsing for valid JSON
arrays, shorthand endpoint tokens, and the default local endpoint is unchanged.

The original standalone proof script was replaced with a regression case in the normal
`codex-supervisor` Vitest suite so routine CI continues to exercise the failure path.

## User Impact

Malformed endpoint configuration now fails with a clear, actionable message instead of leaking a
raw JSON parser exception.

## Evidence

- Before: malformed bracket-prefixed JSON propagated a raw `SyntaxError`.
- After: the same input throws the endpoint-specific configuration error.
- Regression coverage: `extensions/codex-supervisor/src/supervisor.test.ts`.
- Maintainer autoreview found no actionable defects in the production fix and integrated test.
- Fresh hosted CI is running on repaired head `99025b96addef90cded02d7523a8c5a7a04fee2d`.
